title: Skycrane supports wildfire operations
credit: Video by Marc J. Sanchez, BLM/NIFC
description: A Sikorsky S-64 Skycrane helicopter spools up, departs, and draws water from a dip site during suppression operations on the Tamarack Fire in California.  The heavy-lift aircraft utilizes its snorkel system to refill its 2,650-gallon tank in under a minute, providing continuous aerial support to crews on the fire line.(Courtesy video by Marc J. Sanchez/BLM/NIFC)
